card.name: Later digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A digit token that continues a multi-digit number, usually the second or third digit, in dose amounts before mg, Units or mg/kg. It also appears in a few other numbers such as bed numbers or patient counts.

modes.label: Digits in doses
modes.description: Second or last digit of a dose number, often repeating a digit seen earlier in the passage.
